data.name: Kristina
data.gender_notes: Kristina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'Christos' meaning 'anointed one' and 'ina' meaning 'new'. This name was given to girls in ancient Greece as a sign of their dedication to Christ. The name Kristina carries the meaning “Follower of Christ” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kristina usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of christ and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of faith and dedication to God.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kristina total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: קריסטינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קריסטינה הוא נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'כריסטוס' (Χριστός), שפירושה 'המשיח', ומוסיף את הסיומת הנשית '-ינה', שפירושה 'נושאת' או 'מלכה'. הוא מייצג נושאת אור המשיח, מלכה נוצרית שמבטאת אמונה עמוקה במשיח ובהגשמת ערכי הנצרות.

in_greek.name: Χριστίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χριστίνα προέρχεται από το ελληνικό 'Χριστός' (Christos), που σημαίνει 'ορισμένος' ή 'ο χρίστος του Θεού', και προσθέτει το γυναικείο επίθετο '-ίνα', που δηλώνει 'το φως' ή 'η ακολουθία'. Είναι ένα όνομα που συμβολίζει το φως του Χριστού και την πνευματική καθοδήγηση που προσφέρει η πίστη στον Χριστό.

in_latin.name: Christina
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Christina originates from the Latin 'Christi', the genitive form of 'Christus', meaning 'anointed one' or 'Messiah', and the suffix '-ina', indicating 'follower' or 'belonging to'. It denotes a person devoted to Christ, embodying the spiritual journey and commitment to Christian values.

in_english.name: Kristina
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kristina derives from the Greek 'Χριστός' (Christos), meaning 'anointed one' or 'Messiah', and the suffix '-ina', signifying 'follower' or 'woman'. It represents a Christian woman, embodying faith, spirituality, and adherence to Christian principles. Historically, the name has been associated with several Christian saints, reflecting its significance in Christian tradition.
